responsibility: This shell script generates a SYSROOT_SUFFIX_SPEC definition for m68k multilib toolchains by inspecting the target sysroot and the configured MULTILIB_MATCHES and MULTILIB_OPTIONS. It builds GCC spec fragments that map compatible option combinations, such as CPU multilib selections and aliases, to sysroot subdirectories that actually exist. Its purpose is therefore build-time generation of driver sysroot-selection logic, not target code generation.
